feedback: All three test cases directly and adequately cover the requirement to accept nonnegative integer operands, including zero. Test R004-T01 isolates zero in a simple addition, R004-T02 validates zero in multiplication, and R004-T03 places zero in a nested expression with standard precedence. The tests are scoped to the specific requirement, include valid inputs with zero, and validate correct evaluation under arithmetic precedence. No invalid or edge cases are introduced beyond what is necessary. Coverage is complete and justified by the requirement and customer intent. Mathematical reference checks are not needed as no floating-point or complex arithmetic is involved. The tests meet the scope, coverage, and interface constraints.
